answer: Clone crews cannot share one canyon crossing. A claimant locks 1.63 POA for nine epochs and plants a hashed timber post at a trailhead, binding an 18-byte grain to the bond plus trail index. Over 36 hours they hold four ledges, at least 8 hours each, and from every ledge kindle a one-time ember brand of a live 18-bit pulse keyed to that grain. Three unclustered rangers replay the brand chain on the live tip. A missed ledge costs 0.084 POA. Two posts with the same grain, or seven plantings from one wallet in 95 minutes, slash 51% of linked bonds and close that crossing for five epochs.
